class TTLCache:
    """A tiny time-to-live cache. All times are plain ints (seconds)."""

    def __init__(self, ttl):
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._data = {}

    def put(self, key, value, now):
        """Store value under key, stamped at time now."""
        self._data[key] = (value, now)

    def get(self, key, now):
        """Return the value if present and not expired, else None.

        A value is expired when now - t >= ttl (at exactly ttl it is expired).
        """
        if key not in self._data:
            return None
        value, t = self._data[key]
        if now - t > self.ttl:
            return None
        return value

Contract: a value is expired when now - t >= ttl (at exactly ttl it is
expired). get returns the stored value while fresh and None once expired
or absent.
"""

import unittest

from ttlcache import TTLCache


class TTLCacheTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_absent_key_returns_none(self):
        cache = TTLCache(ttl=5)
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get("missing", now=100))

    def test_fresh_value_returned(self):
        cache = TTLCache(ttl=5)
        cache.put("k", "v", now=10)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get("k", now=14), "v")

    def test_same_second_is_fresh(self):
        cache = TTLCache(ttl=5)
        cache.put("k", 42, now=0)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get("k", now=0), 42)

    def test_expires_at_exactly_ttl(self):
        """Boundary: now - t == ttl must already be expired."""
        cache = TTLCache(ttl=5)
        cache.put("k", "v", now=10)
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get("k", now=15))

    def test_expires_past_ttl(self):
        cache = TTLCache(ttl=5)
        cache.put("k", "v", now=10)
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get("k", now=16))

    def test_reput_refreshes_expiry(self):
        cache = TTLCache(ttl=5)
        cache.put("k", "old", now=0)
        cache.put("k", "new", now=10)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get("k", now=14), "new")
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get("k", now=15))

    def test_ttl_zero_is_always_expired(self):
        """ttl=0: 0 - t >= 0 at the same timestamp, so it never lives."""
        cache = TTLCache(ttl=0)
        cache.put("k", "v", now=10)
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get("k", now=10))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
